rows.grounds: the wrongdoing or demerit under discussion
demonstrative referring back to the sin

items.question: Into what does sin transform when the deity is graciously pleased?
premises: Sin may be present in an action.
The deity's gracious pleasure alters the condition of sin.
That same sin becomes righteousness itself.
items.inference: Sin is transmuted into dharma through divine favor.
uncertainties: The gender agreement of saḥ with pāpam is read contextually as referring to that sin.
items.plain_english: That sin indeed becomes righteousness itself.
